name: Viewstats
summary: Research platform for YouTube creators: outlier videos, channel statistics, thumbnail analysis and saved idea boards.
description: Analytics and research platform for YouTube creators, built by the team behind MrBeast's analytics. It surfaces outlier videos, tracks channel and video performance with real-time data, ranks channels in top lists, analyzes thumbnails and stores inspiration in research boards, with alerts for competitor activity. Free account available; Pro and Business are paid plans.
contains: outlier video discovery from real-time YouTube data
top lists: Top 100 channels by subscribers and views
free account plus Pro and Business plans (Business from $249/mo)
